info.name: AUT-4666 Asset Search API (ticket smoke)
info.description:
Jira attachment / importable Postman Collection v2.1 for https://oat-sa.atlassian.net/browse/AUT-4666

Folders map to AUT-4666 acceptance criteria (not implementation step letters).

## Auth
1. Import this collection + environment `AUT-4666 Asset Search`.
2. Select the environment.
3. Run **00 Auth** (CSRF then Login).
4. Collection pre-request injects `Cookie: tao={{taoSession}}`.

## Endpoint
`GET /taoItems/ItemContent/files` — browse (no query) vs search (non-empty query).

## Token rules (HKD-1996)
- ≥3 chars → prefix; <3 → exact
- Haystack: label, name, location, alt, uri
